summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil-icons@14.5.9 declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into an OS temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync with the bundled file math_init.js as its argument. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-cjs bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array rotation and a large opaque token table (function WV8StW shifting array head, n7gIxM token table) consistent with obfuscator.io-style protection. The package is advertised as an icon library and has no functional need for a second language runtime; the payload is executed under Bun rather than Node, keeping the Node process out of the execution path and the payload contents outside straightforward Node-level inspection. On `npm install`, this results in execution of an opaque, obfuscated binary bundle under the installer's account before any user code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
